items.source_excerpt: MANAMA — Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman announced Tuesday that the Kingdom has restored 5.8 million barrels per day of operational capacity through the East-West Pipeline as of Tuesday morning.Speaking during a panel discussion at the Made in GCC 2026 Forum and Exhibition in Manama, Prince Abdulaziz said the Kingdom had restored the pipeline’s operational capacity to the 5.8 million bpd level.The East-West Pipeline is one of Saudi Arabia’s main crude oil transportation routes, connecting production areas in the east of the Kingdom with export terminals on the Red Sea coast.
